description.content: Retrieves the runtime management configuration for a function's version. If the runtime update mode is Manual, this includes the ARN of the runtime version and the runtime update mode. If the runtime update mode is Auto or Function update, this includes the runtime update mode and null is returned for the ARN. For more information, see Runtime updates.

description.content:
Amazon API Gateway

Amazon API Gateway helps developers deliver robust, secure, and scalable mobile and web application back ends. API Gateway allows developers to securely connect mobile and web applications to APIs that run on AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, or other publicly addressable web services that are hosted outside of AWS.
